Title: How to qualify for the EC 2015 in Poland

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
> oursvache wrote:
> Is there a place where I can find info on how a player qualifies for the EC ?
>
-Win any 8+ player tournament.
-Be a finalist in a National Championship
-Get a game win at a (European Championships) Qualifier (Last Chance Qualifier at Warsaw will be final such event)

I wouldn't worry about being qualified.
I've always had fun at EC whether I was qualified or not; casual games and good company really rock!

Besides, every day there is always two different events going on at EC and you can attend one of them even if you are not qualified (= on Saturday's Day 1 there'll probably be a draft or Silence of Death tournament for non-qualified players and on Sunday's Day 2 there will be First Chance Qualifier.)

Attend.
Socialize.
Play some cards.
Booze up with like minded mates.
Enjoy.

Finnish  Politics!
